name: Dubki Wale Aloo Chana
ingredients: Ginger, jeera, hing and ½ tsp oil
steps: Add boiled potato and kala chana.
Mash some potato and chana into the gravy.
note: Use more kala chana and less potato.

inspirationReferences.title: The Real Mathura ke Dubki Wale Aloo I Aloo Ki Subji I Aloo Jhol
inspirationReferences.note: A Mathura home-town account of the thin, spicy potato broth, freshly ground whole spices and long simmer; it also notes bathua can replace spinach in the green masala. This informed the regional gravy character, not the protein adaptation.

inspirationReferences.title: Dubki Wale Aloo Recipe
inspirationReferences.note: A Mathura-style version describes the ginger, green-chilli, tomato and whole-spice profile and the thin gravy served with puri or kachori; used as a variation reference.

inspirationReferences.title: Dubki Wale Aloo Recipe - Potatoes In A Spicy North Indian Gravy
inspirationReferences.note: The page identifies the dish with Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, and describes its no-onion-no-garlic, ginger-tomato, whole-spice gravy and breakfast pairing with puri. This informed regional framing; the Kitchen version's added chickpeas and protein adaptation are original.
